name: Grape Juice
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Take the contents of 1 basket grapes, wash and stem
Put on stove with just enough water to cover
Let come to a boil, remove from fire and pour into cheese cloth bag
When cool enough, press out the juice with the hands
Put juice back on stove with 2 pounds sugar for each basket
Bottle while hot, cork and seal with paraffine wax, to exclude the air

source.originalInstructions:
1. Take the contents of 1 basket grapes, wash and stem
2. Put on stove with just enough water to cover
3. Let come to a boil, remove from fire and pour into cheese cloth bag
4. When cool enough, press out the juice with the hands
5. Put juice back on stove with 2 pounds sugar for each basket
6. Let come to a boil
7. Bottle while hot, cork and seal with paraffine wax, to exclude the air
